heading: Like-for-like revenue increased by +3.4M across CFH014, CFH017, CFH018 and CFH021, as transactions +240.1K offset lower units -249.9K and Basket Size -0.10.
paragraphs: Like-for-like revenue rose by +3.4M across the four comparable branches.
Transactions increased by +240.1K across CFH014, CFH017, CFH018 and CFH021, showing more transactions (bills) than last year.
The overall result remained positive in revenue terms even with weaker item sales per transaction.
Units fell by -249.9K across the same like-for-like branch group, so item demand was lower than last year.
Basket Size declined by -0.10, meaning each transaction contained fewer items on average.
The revenue gain was not supported by units growth, with more transactions offset by smaller baskets.
Review branch-level performance for CFH014, CFH017, CFH018 and CFH021 to see where the +240.1K transactions increase and the -249.9K units decline were concentrated.
Compare category performance within the like-for-like branches to identify which areas contributed most to the -0.10 Basket Size change.
Monitor whether the current pattern holds, with revenue +3.4M supported by transactions +240.1K while units remain -249.9K.
